description: Pre-BoltFFI UniFFI/JNA transport baseline. Immutable historical evidence for migration gates; BoltFFI results must not overwrite these numbers.

boltffi_pin_at_baseline.policy: latest formal tag preferred; exact official SHA only when required fix is unreleased
boltffi_pin_at_baseline.note: Historical pin when UniFFI baseline was frozen (pre-v0.28.0). Production pin is boltffi_production_pin.

boltffi_production_pin.policy: formal tag tip SHA; CLI and boltffi_core share one rev

generated_kotlin.note: Measured from the working tree before UniFFI deletion.

native_bytes.profile_note: size-baseline.v1.json holds release-like production packaging sizes used for volume gates. Working-tree app/jniLibs may be larger when built with the dev profile.

notes: Warm generation/packaging and Android state/planner/callback samples are recorded under STAGE1-EVIDENCE.md when BF-00 measurement commands complete on the migration host.
BoltFFI comparison samples must use the same host, workload, and build profile; UniFFI numbers here are the migration baseline only.

measurement_notes: Do not overwrite this file with BoltFFI results.
Post-migration evidence belongs in STAGE1-EVIDENCE.md and a separate boltffi comparison document if needed.
Exit gate: four-ABI final Lomo native total bytes must not exceed release-like liblomo_native + libjnidispatch sum; JNA bytes must become zero.
